records.text: Before joining Burisma's board, I attended Yale Law School, served in the Clinton administration, chaired the U.S. board of the World Food Program, served on 16 boards, and taught at Georgetown.

verification.notes: Yale Law School, the Clinton Commerce Department appointment, World Food Program USA chairmanship, numerous corporate and nonprofit boards, and Georgetown teaching are independently documented before or around the Burisma appointment. The exact total of 16 boards was not corroborated by a source-complete roster, so the resume's main elements are true while that precise count remains uncertain.
